description: Plan tier, trial state, connected account count, accountLimit (how many accounts the plan allows, extra accounts included), monthlyPosts (posts used this month against the monthly cap, null when there is no cap), dailyPosts (only on a plan with a daily cap, by UTC day), scheduled post counts by status, and the next three upcoming posts. Posted counts include old posts imported from Instagram and TikTok: postedHere is the posts made with sprkly, postedImported the imported ones. Never returns tokens or secrets.

title: Get account summary
